d: In this episode of Rajdoot, Hosted by Nikhil, Written by Sajid, we look at the growing possibility of another major US-Israel military operation against Iran after the November midterm elections. We examine the US military buildup across the Middle East, the reported strike on Iran's Qeshm Island, and why American military transport aircraft are delivering air defence equipment to Israel. We also explore Tucker Carlson's alarming claims about a possible nuclear strike on Iran, how Iran is preparing its citizens for a nuclear attack, and whether Washington is heading towards another…
